verdict.rationale: Braintrust's Experiments feature is explicitly described as an immutable, comparable record of eval runs that tracks progress over time and integrates into CI/CD to catch regressions, and Playgrounds let users run full evaluations and compare results side-by-side across prompt/model configurations. This directly matches the story of comparing eval runs to catch regressions between versions. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the side-by-side comparison UI beyond first-party docs.
